items.review_rationale: Reviewed the complete local ambient and coefficient subrings, residue-field isomorphism and contraction condition, retaining the characteristic parameter and local embeddings.

references.phrase: local ring and its maximal ideal
subring Lambda of R that is complete and local
residue field of a local ring
references.context: Quotient R/m and corresponding quotient of Lambda by its maximal ideal, as fields.
Map from Lambda/(Lambda intersect m) to R/m induced by the subring inclusion is bijective as a field map.
Characteristic of R/m, either zero or a positive prime, used in the equality Lambda intersect m=pLambda.
Ideal generated in Lambda by the image of integer p under the canonical integers-to-Lambda homomorphism.

references.disposition: This is a precise coefficient-ring compatibility condition; it does not require Lambda to equal the whole ambient ring.

items.review_rationale: Read the Cohen ring as a complete discrete valuation ring whose unique maximal ideal equals the ideal generated by a prime integer, avoiding confusion with the Cohen–Macaulay condition.

references.context: Positive prime number viewed inside the valuation ring via the integer structure map, not a prime ideal itself.
Set pR of all multiples of p inside the valuation ring, asserted to equal its maximal ideal.

references.disposition: The term denotes a complete discrete valuation ring of specified residue characteristic, not the depth/dimension Cohen–Macaulay property.
